title: Motif line with the project's psc-motif-zigzag-3pt.pmf at 5 x 5 mm, spacing 2 mm
description: A 40 x 40 mm square's outline sewn as a motif line with the project's 3-point motif (base line with its middle point dragged to (512,768)) at 5 mm long and 5 mm high, spacing 2 mm, run pitch 5 mm, Start/End Feed: each motif's apex is 1.25 mm off the outline (256 of the 1024-unit cell at 5 mm), so a motif's two stitches are about 2.8 mm, and the motifs stay on the outline, which bounds the stitches at 40 x 40 mm. Replaces line-motif-zigzag-3pt, withdrawn with its capture (#1060).
